title: appbox pipeline state
description: The single source of truth for a run. Targets live here in state, never in CLI flags (architecture §11). Approval tokens are minted only by a human at a gate — never by an agent.

phase.description: Current FSM phase: intake | prototype | design | scaffold | review | build | deploy.

targets.description: Platforms targeted, e.g. ["macos"]. Platform-only; viewports derive (§11).

approvalTokens.description: One key per human gate that has been passed. Absent = not approved.

designHash.description: Hash of the frozen design inputs. Changes here invalidate downstream artifacts.

kitSha.description: The vendored kit SHA this run is pinned to.
